correctness.rationale: A 288-heptad graph is exhaustively constructed from the classical theta parity rule and checked against the 8+280 graph-shape classification. Its 28-by-288 incidence Gram matrix is exactly 56I+16J, yielding determinant 2^160 7^287. For each of four removed vertices, integer modular Smith elimination at p=2 and p=7 yields elementary divisors 2^4 once, 2^6 twenty-six times, 7 two-hundred-thirty-five times, and 7^2 twenty-six times; sums reproduce the determinant. The 2-primary group also follows from a 27-by-27 Schur-matrix argument.

value.rationale: The complete chip-firing group is a canonical exact integral invariant of a highly structured 316-vertex algebraic-geometric incidence graph. Its 7-torsion extensions of order 49 and 2-torsion exponent 64 are not determined by the previously known 8+280 geometry, the spectrum, or the number of spanning trees; a full integral classification is useful for lattice comparisons and graph Jacobians.
